summary: Fixed Item 9/10/11 and Page 2 Taxpayer's Name comb-tick strike-through on long text (via shared [data-overflow-of] white band at 8835479d; per-form comb masks removed), Items 19 & 21 overpayment printing (8835479d), Schedule 1 corporate stock shrink-to-fit, and Schedule 1 & 2 text padding and right-aligned currency columns. Long Taxpayer's Name (>26 chars) fell back to proportional text rendered over visible vertical comb ticks.
